Definition: neuter of a compound of G3844 and the base of G4139 (as adverb); close by, i.e. (figuratively) almost:--nigh unto.
BiblicalUsage: Paraplesion means close by, almost, nigh unto. It appears once, in Philippians 2:27, where Epaphroditus was sick nigh unto death, but God had mercy on him, and on Paul also.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God stood that close to death with Epaphroditus and turned him back, and mercy is never nearer than when life is almost gone.
